audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Timothy text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for false teaching, Law use, mercy, trustworthy saying, conscience, Hymenaeus/Alexander. Pastoral Epistles require second-pass source/authorship and reception-history audit.

verses.restored: Paul, apostle of Messiah Jesus according to command of Divine our Savior/Healer and Messiah Jesus our hope,

familiar.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

verses.restored: to Timothy, genuine child in trust: grace, mercy, peace from Divine Father and Messiah Jesus our Lord.

familiar.text: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.restored: Just as I appealed to you to remain in Ephesus when I was going into Macedonia, so that you might instruct certain ones not to teach differently,

familiar.text: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

verses.restored: nor to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which produce speculations rather than stewardship/administration of the Divine that is in trust.

familiar.text: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

verses.restored: But the aim of the instruction is love from a pure heart and a good conscience and unhypocritical trust.

familiar.text: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

verses.restored: Some, having missed these things, turned aside into empty talk,

familiar.text: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

verses.restored: wishing to be teachers of Law, not understanding either what they say or concerning what they insist.

familiar.text: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

verses.restored: But we know that the Law is beautiful/good if one uses it lawfully,

familiar.text: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

verses.restored: knowing this: that Law is not laid down for a righteous/just one but for lawless and disorderly ones, irreverent and sinners/misaligned, unholy and profane, those striking parents, murderers,

familiar.text: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

verses.restored: sexually immoral/misusing, those exploiting males sexually, enslavers/kidnappers, liars, perjurers, and if anything else is opposed to healthy teaching,

familiar.text: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

verses.restored: according to the good news of the glory of the blessed Divine, with which I was entrusted.

familiar.text: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

verses.restored: I have gratitude to the One empowering me, Messiah Jesus our Lord, because he considered me trustworthy, appointing me to service,

familiar.text: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

verses.restored: though formerly being a blasphemer and pursuer/persecutor and violent-insolent one; but I was shown mercy, because I acted ignorantly in untrust.

familiar.text: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

verses.restored: And the grace of our Lord overflowed with trust and love that are in Messiah Jesus.

familiar.text: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.restored: Trustworthy is the saying and worthy of full welcome: Messiah Jesus came into the world to save/heal sinners/misaligned ones, of whom I am foremost.

familiar.text: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

verses.restored: But because of this I was shown mercy, so that in me, foremost, Messiah Jesus might show all patience, as a pattern for those about to trust upon him into age-long life.

familiar.text: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

verses.restored: Now to the King of the ages, incorruptible, invisible, only Divine, honor and glory into the ages of the ages. Amen.

familiar.text: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.restored: This instruction I place before you, child Timothy, according to the prophecies previously made concerning you, so that by them you may wage the beautiful/good warfare,

familiar.text: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

verses.restored: having trust and good conscience, which some have rejected and suffered shipwreck concerning the trust.

familiar.text: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

verses.restored: Among whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I handed over to the adversarial one so that they may be trained not to blaspheme.

familiar.text: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

translation_notes: The aim of instruction is love, not control. This frames the chapter's polemic against speculative teaching.
Vice-list terms in 1:10 require care; arsenokoitai is rendered those exploiting males sexually, not as a blanket category for loving queer relationships.
Handed over language in 1:20 is disciplinary/restorative training language, not permission for cruelty.
